source: Place and rotate small block shapes on a 10×10 board. Fill a complete row or column to clear it and keep playing.
translation: Mahali na kuzunguka maumbo ndogo block juu ya bodi 10×10. Kujaza safu kamili au nguzo ya wazi na kuendelea kucheza.
